score_rationale: Strong, race-clean loop core (8+ in isolation) gated by an under-hardened perimeter: 2 P0 (system-wide hang, prompt-injection blast radius) and 15 P1 incl. host-file corruption, data-loss on resume/crash, conversation-bricking, accidental OOM, secret broadcast, plus absent operational observability. All fixes localized; post Phase 0-1 re-score 7.5-8.
